title: Click Wheel
subject: the-2000s
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: Gadgets from a decade that carried a separate device for everything.

entries.clue: Fruit-named handset with a full keyboard
Heavy flat screen that lost out to LCD
Profile page that made you rank your friends
Little eye clipped to the monitor
Slim Motorola flip phone of 2004, vowels omitted
Microsoft's 2006 answer to a music player
Maker whose Pilot organiser took a stylus
Pocket player steered with a thumb
Box that let you pause live television

factCards.text: Apple announced the first iPod on 23 October 2001, with a 5 GB hard drive and a mechanical scroll wheel.
factCards.sourceTitle: Apple Newsroom — Apple Presents iPod, 23 October 2001

factCards.text: Napster's original service was shut down in July 2001 following injunctions in A&M Records, Inc. v. Napster, Inc.
factCards.sourceTitle: US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit — A&M Records, Inc. v. Napster, Inc., 239 F.3d 1004 (2001)

factCards.text: MySpace was the most visited social networking site in the United States for parts of 2006 and 2007 by some measurement firms; rankings from that period differ by methodology.
